name: Black Market TV 01

date.source: The fed's own event poster (posted 14 October 2017), advertising the broadcast for 21 October 2017

evidence.source: The Death Collective's own Black Market TV 01 event poster, posted 14 October 2017
evidence.note: Advertises Castor Strife vs. an opponent named only "[Name Withheld]" in the fed's own promotional text, Simon Lineker vs. Nuckelavee, Ill Fortune vs. Money Talks, and Haircules vs. Nagasaki Fire, plus broadcast appearances by wrestling personality Mike "The Wolf" Randalls and multi-time champion "The First." No results document for this broadcast survives on the record.

notes: Advertised opponents Haircules, Nagasaki Fire, Mike "The Wolf" Randalls and "The First," and Castor Strife's own advertised opponent (billed in the source only as "[Name Withheld]", an in-text placeholder rather than a redaction made by the museum), are not minted as characters -- each survives only as a name on this one advertisement, with no further detail.
